opener_concept: A number machine: double it, then add 3 (f(x)=2x+3). Box 1 runs it forwards (put in 4, out 11 = f(4)); box 2 runs it backwards (out 13, so 5 went in = the inverse); the reveal names evaluate/invert/iterate as the whole lesson, all from one machine. Same concrete angle as the Edexcel sibling, re-numbered to the eduqas bank's f(x)=2x+3 and self-verified.
